summary.intent: Improve the summary TUI browser: reorder filters, remove noisy table columns, add lipgloss styling to the detail page, fix 'q' quit, widen column spacing, and add on-demand summary/facet generation.
summary.outcome: All three UX improvements and three bug fixes were implemented and committed: filter reorder (Repo default), column removal, styled detail page, 'q' quit, wider column spacing, and a 'g' keybinding that triggers async LLM-based summary+facet generation from the detail view. 18 tests pass.

repo: summarytui uses Bubble Tea's viewport for detail scrolling — detail content is a flat ANSI string, not a layout tree; styling must be done inline via lipgloss string renders
branchFilter iota order determines the default filter (zero value = first constant), so making filterRepo first means no explicit initialization is needed

generateForSession in summary_cmd.go reads the transcript from the checkpoint store, calls Claude for summary, extracts facets, persists to insightsdb, and returns the updated SessionRow — it owns its own db connection
When a generate completes, the row must be updated in three places: rows (master list), filteredRows (visible slice), and detailPage.row
summarytui.GenerateFunc decouples the TUI from the LLM/db pipeline; tests pass a mock func returning immediately
filterRepo matches both 'main' and 'master' branch names

code.finding: GenerateFunc type + generateFn field on rootModel; generateDoneMsg/generateErrMsg Bubble Tea messages for async generation result
canGenerate flag gates showing 'g generate' in help bar; status field shows Generating.../Generated/error inline
generateForSession function added; passed into RunWithCurrentBranch as the GenerateFunc
detailLabel uses fixed Width(14) for aligned key-value columns; sectionHeader uses box-drawing chars in amber; removed unused statusFlag()

workflow: Bubble Tea async pattern: tea.Cmd runs in a goroutine so LLM calls don't block the UI; set a 'generating' status immediately, clear it on result message
To get visual column spacing in bubbles/table, you must increase column Width values — the widget adds no inter-column gaps automatically
A pre-commit hook auto-converted fmt.Sprintf integer formatting to strconv.Itoa, requiring a strconv import addition after the hook ran
gofmt can strip nolint comments from capabilities.go as a side effect — discard those unrelated changes before committing

friction: Pre-commit hook silently rewrote fmt.Sprintf to strconv.Itoa, causing a compile failure until strconv was manually added to imports
replace_all was accidentally used with a nolint comment on a newRootModel call, creating a nonsensical edit that had to be corrected
Multiple rounds of test fixes were needed as the default filter change (filterRepo) cascaded through tests that assumed filterCurrentBranch was the default
newDetailModel and newRootModel signature changes required touching every call site across two test files
open_items: Pre-existing ineffassign lint warning on summary_cmd.go line 145 was not fixed
Pre-existing lint issues in other files (not summarytui) were left untouched
No test added for generateForSession itself in summary_cmd_test.go — only the TUI dispatch is tested
